text: What if all wood on Earth vanished for five seconds? Bad news. You're sitting on some.
Every chair, gone. A whole lecture hall hits the floor. Your pasta lives on the carpet now.
Every tree vanishes. Three trillion. The leaves just hang there. Then, green blizzard.
Every piano loses its wood. Twenty tons of string tension, let go at once. Loudest chord in history.
Every staircase, gone. Halfway up? Not anymore. Every door, too. Your boss saw you napping.
Every pencil. Every chopstick. Every baseball bat, mid swing.
The trees are back. The leaves are not. Every dad with a leaf blower? Best day of his life.
What should vanish next? Say it in the comments, or I pick something worse.
